design.site_summary: A partially shaded balcony microclimate for a curious cat named Barnaby.
design.layout_strategy: Trailing plants on the railing at eye level, upright succulents at mid height against the wall, and a low grazing ground layer along the balcony edge.
design.combination_logic: The combination contrasts the fine weeping stems of trailing succulents with the thick, architectural rosettes of upright species, creating a layered visual rhythm that shifts from deep green structural forms to delicate textured highlights.

zones.placement: on the east-facing railing, 3 h of morning sun, sheltered from the afternoon heat

plants.why: Fits the vertical hanging layer by providing architectural trailing stems.
plants.role_in_combination: Contributes linear texture and a stark contrasting vertical green element.

maintenance: Water sparingly once every two weeks in summer.
Inspect stems for dust and gently wipe clean.

zones.placement: on the back wall shelf, 3 h of morning sun, bright indirect light

plants.why: Fits the mid layer with a robust architectural form.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides strong focal height and fleshy textural contrast against smaller succulents.

plants.why: Complements the mid layer with woody stems and glossy leaves.
plants.role_in_combination: Adds structural depth and a darker green tone to balance brighter foliage.

maintenance: Water thoroughly when soil is completely dry.
Fertilize once in spring with a balanced succulent feed.

zones.placement: in the accessible floor corner, 3 h of morning sun, highly reachable by pets

plants.why: Provides a safe, low-level tactile element for the ground zone.
plants.role_in_combination: Serves as the tactile anchor for the ground level, offering sturdy rounded leaves.

maintenance: Check soil moisture weekly and water only when dry.
Remove any fallen lower leaves to keep the base clean.

care_instructions.task: Water all containers deeply until runoff occurs
care_instructions.frequency: every ten days in summer, monthly in winter

care_instructions.task: Check for pests such as mealybugs on succulent stems
Rotate pots to ensure even light exposure

care_cautions: Overwatering the Pencil Cactus in the hanging zone can lead to root rot.
Frost exposure in winter can damage the tender foliage of the Aloe vera on the wall shelf.
Poor drainage in the balcony floor corner pot can cause waterlogging for the Chinese Jade.
design.pet_safety_note: The design keeps Barnaby safe by avoiding highly toxic species in accessible grazing zones and monitoring all plant interactions.
